events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.title: 影子寄存处
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
石壁间嵌着一间寄存处。你还没走近，自己的影子已经靠在柜台上，不耐烦地敲着桌面。

柜员从一排空衣钩间抬起头，把一张收据推给你。

「一张牌，[gold]{Gold}[/gold]枚金币。到这层的大门前，送还给你。我们会替你……[gold]收拾一下[/gold]。」
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.D: 支付[gold]{Gold}金币[/gold]。寄存[blue]{Cards}[/blue]张牌，本章Boss战前[green]升级[/green]并归还。
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.A: 你已经领过一张收据了。
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.selectionPrompt: 选择一张牌寄存。本章Boss战前升级并归还。
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.DEPOSITED.descrip:
柜员捏住牌的一角，轻轻一抖。它变成了一件薄薄的黑衣，被挂到身后的衣钩上。

「不会弄丢吧？」

柜员看了看你脚下。

「你的影子知道路。」

你收好收据。离开时，影子比平常轻快了一点。
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.LEAVE.description:
你招呼影子离开。它又敲了两下柜台，才不情愿地贴回脚下。

柜员把收据收了回去。

「下次请一起到。」
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
你把伸出去的手收了回来。

柜员没有催促，只把空衣钩转向了下一位。你脚下的影子叹了口气。
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.COINS.description:
影子从柜台缝里摸出几枚[gold]金币[/gold]。柜员看了一眼，没有拦它。

[green]“失物终于有人领了。”[/green]

relics.SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.title: 寄存收据
relics.SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.description: 在本章Boss战前，归还并[green]升级[/green]寄存的牌。

events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.title: Shadow Cloakroom
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
A cloakroom is tucked into the cavern wall. Your shadow is already at the counter, tapping its fingers impatiently.

The clerk looks up from a row of empty hooks and slides you a claim ticket.

"One card. [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Back before the big door. We will give it a little... [gold]attention[/gold]."
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.D: Pay [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold]. Store [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card. It returns [green]Upgraded[/green] before this Act's Boss.
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.A: You have already collected a claim ticket.
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.selectionPrompt: Store a card. It returns Upgraded before this Act's Boss.
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.DEPOSITED.descrip:
The clerk takes the card by one corner and gives it a shake. It unfolds into a thin black coat, which goes on a hook behind the counter.

"You won't lose it?"

The clerk glances at your feet.

"Your shadow knows the way."

You pocket the ticket. Your shadow seems a little lighter on the way out.
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.LEAVE.description:
You beckon your shadow away. It taps the counter twice more before reluctantly settling beneath your feet.

The clerk puts the ticket away.

"Next time, arrive together."
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
You draw your hand back.

The clerk does not hurry you, simply turning the empty hook toward the next customer. Your shadow sighs.
events.SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.COINS.description:
Your shadow fishes a few [gold]coins[/gold] out of a crack in the counter. The clerk makes no objection.

[green]“Finally. Someone claimed them.”[/green]

relics.SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.title: Claim Ticket
relics.SHADOW_CLAIM_TICKET.description: Before this Act's Boss, return and [green]Upgrade[/green] the stored card.
